title: Neutral repetition becomes claimable at exactly the third occurrence

boundary.expect: second occurrence of the position; not yet claimable

rationale: Two generals shuttle inside their palaces with no check and no attack by either side. The starting position stands at plies 0, 4 and 8; on the third it becomes eligible for a draw claim and never earlier. A neutral repetition is claimable rather than terminal: the game continues unless the claim is made.
